This is a list of notable [[Opinion poll|polling]] organizations by country. All the major [[television network]]s, alone or in conjunction with the largest newspapers or magazines, in virtually every country with elections, operate their own versions of polling operations, in collaboration or independently through various applications.

Several organizations try to monitor the behavior of polling firms and the use of polling and statistical data, including the [[Pew Research Center]] and, in Canada, the Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy.<ref>[http://www.wlu.ca/lispop/ Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy]</ref>

<!--Entries in this list should be "notable" (see WP:GNG) and already have a sourced Wikipedia article (see WP:WTAF).-->

==Australia==
*[[ACNielsen]] – formerly published in [[Fairfax Media]] newspapers, withdrawn in 2014<ref name=inside2019/>
*[[Essential Media Communications]] – formerly published on [[Crikey]] website, now in ''[[Guardian Australia]]''<ref name=inside2019/>
*DemosAU - Pollster and market research firm, publishes political and issue based polling across media outlets, specialises in [[Multilevel regression with poststratification|MRP modelling]] and Conversational AI research. 
*[[Galaxy Research]] – now part of YouGov<ref name=inside2019/>
*[[Ipsos Australia]] – published in [[Nine Entertainment]]'s newspapers, ''[[Sydney Morning Herald]]'', ''[[The Age]]'' and the ''[[Australian Financial Review]]'',<ref name=inside2019/> but withdrew from political polling after an unpredicted result in the [[2019 Australian federal election|2019 election]],<ref>{{cite web | last=Wahlquist | first=Calla | title=Sydney Morning Herald and Age to stop running Ipsos poll after surprise election result | website=[[The Guardian]]| date=23 May 2019 | url=http://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/may/24/sydney-morning-herald-and-age-to-stop-running-ipsos-poll-after-surprise-election-result | access-date=12 February 2022}}</ref> although continues the relationship with other polls<ref name=smhtopic>{{cite web | last=Singhal | first=Pallavi | last2=Topsfield | first2=Jewel | title=Topic - Ipsos poll | website=[[Sydney Morning Herald]] | date=5 February 2021 | url=https://www.smh.com.au/topic/ipsos-poll-jks | access-date=12 February 2022}}</ref> 
*[[Newspoll]] – published in [[News Corp Australia]]'s ''[[The Australian]]'' newspaper<ref name=inside2019/>
*[https://pyxispolling.com/ Pyxis Polling and Insights] - Contracted to conduct Newspoll for the Australian, also conducts internal polling for the Australian Labor Party and corporate clients.
*[[ReachTEL]] – used by Nine Entertainment for single-seat and state election polling<ref name=inside2019/>
*[[Roy Morgan]] – published online and given away<ref name=inside2019/>
*[[UComms]], which has links to unions [[ACTU]] and [[CFMMEU]] – formerly used by Fairfax, then by Nine Entertainment for single-seat and state elections<ref name=inside2019/>
*[[YouGov]] – published in News Corp Australia's ''[[Weekly Times]]''<ref name=inside2019>{{cite web | title=Who controls opinion polling in Australia, what else we need to know about the polls, and why it matters | website=Inside Story | date=15 May 2019 | url=https://insidestory.org.au/who-controls-opinion-polling-in-australia/  |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220211/https://insidestory.org.au/who-controls-opinion-polling-in-australia/  |archive-date=2022-02-11 |url-status=live| access-date=11 February 2022}}{{cbignore}}</ref>

==United States==
Statistician [[Nate Silver]], formerly of ''[[FiveThirtyEight]]'', maintained a list of pollsters who conduct surveys in U.S. political elections and assigns each pollster a rating based on its [[methodology]] and historical accuracy.<ref name="Silver">Nate Silver, [https://web.archive.org/web/20141005201227/http://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/pollster-ratings/ FiveThirtyEight's Pollster Ratings], ''FiveThirtyEight'' (last accessed October 6, 2016).</ref> Silver also lists the number of polls analyzed for each pollster.<ref name="Silver"/>
*[https://www.cygn.al/ Cygnal]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Buchanan |first=Brent |date=2018-12-06 |title=Why the New York Times Named Us the Most Accurate Pollster in the Country |url=https://www.cygn.al/why-the-new-york-times-named-us-the-most-accurate-pollster-in-the-country/ |access-date=2023-06-19 |website=Cygnal |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Cohn |first=Nate |date=2023-02-03 |title=Is Trump Way Up or Way Down? |language=en-US |work=The New York Times |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/02/03/upshot/polls-trump-desantis-republicans.html |access-date=2023-06-19 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Silver |first=Nate |date=2023-03-09 |title=Pollster Ratings - Cygnal |url=https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/pollster-ratings/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141005201227/http://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/pollster-ratings/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=October 5, 2014 |access-date=2023-06-19 |website=FiveThirtyEight |language=en}}</ref>
